rows.headcount_source_title: VA Department-level workforce (FY24 budget rollup; ~482,000 employees)
rows.headcount_quote: VA is the second-largest federal department, employing approximately 482,000 people across VHA, VBA, NCA, and Departmental staff offices.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Department total ~482k; ~370k VHA clinical/custodial/wage-grade staff at ~10% eligible plus ~110k VBA/OIT/NCA/staff offices at ~80% eligible blends to ~0.30.
rows.notes: Excludes contractors. FY24 budget rollup includes VHA (370k), VBA (~30k), NCA (~2k), Departmental admin (~80k).

rows.headcount_quote: VHA is the largest integrated health care system in the United States, providing care at 1,380 health care facilities... employing more than 371,000 health care professionals and support staff.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Predominantly clinical (physicians, nurses, allied health), custodial, food service, and shift-based facilities staff; only ~10% (admin, research, IT, claims processors at VHA) are plausible LLM users.
rows.notes: Largest integrated health system in U.S.; FTE excludes ~75k VA medical school trainees.

rows.headcount_quote: VBA employs approximately 30,000 staff at 56 regional offices processing disability, education (GI Bill), home loan, and pension benefits for veterans and their families.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Claims processors, rating veterans service representatives, loan specialists, and education counselors are knowledge workers at desks — high LLM-plausible share.
rows.notes: FY24 ABR cites ~28-30k FTE; growth from PACT Act backlog hiring.

rows.headcount_quote: NCA maintains 155 national cemeteries and 34 soldiers' lots... with approximately 2,100 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Predominantly cemetery groundskeeping, equipment operations, and burial-services field staff; ~25% are HQ administrative/IT/scheduling/customer-service roles.
rows.notes: Smallest VA administration; field staff dominate.

rows.headcount_source_title: VA Office of Information & Technology — About OIT
rows.headcount_quote: OIT delivers IT services to VA's three administrations and staff offices with approximately 8,500 employees nationwide.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Knowledge-work-heavy IT bureau (software engineers, network engineers, cybersecurity, PMO, data) — nearly all roles are LLM-plausible.
rows.notes: OIT runs VistA, MyHealtheVet, EHR modernization (with OEHRM).

rows.headcount_quote: With more than 260,000 employees, DHS is one of the largest federal departments... including agents and officers from CBP, ICE, TSA, Coast Guard, USCIS, FEMA, and Secret Service.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Weighted mix: ~60k CBP frontline + ~42k Coast Guard military + ~50k TSA screeners (all ~0.05-0.10) dominate; balanced by ~25k USCIS adjudicators, ~10k CISA, ~20k FEMA, ~20k ICE, ~15k Mgmt/HQ knowledge workers.
rows.notes: Includes ~42k uniformed Coast Guard active duty + ~7k reserves. Excludes ~200k DHS contractors.

rows.headcount_source_title: About CBP — U.S. Customs and Border Protection
rows.headcount_quote: CBP is one of the world's largest law enforcement organizations and is charged with keeping terrorists and their weapons out of the U.S. ... more than 65,000 employees, including Border Patrol agents, Air and Marine officers, CBP officers, agricultural specialists, and trade specialists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: ~45k frontline Border Patrol agents/CBP officers/AMO + ~5k agricultural specialists at field POEs are exclusion-eligible; ~15k trade specialists, intel analysts, HQ admin, and IT are LLM-plausible.
rows.notes: Frontline officer count grew post-FY24 hiring surge.

rows.headcount_source_title: About ICE — U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement
rows.headcount_quote: ICE has more than 20,000 employees in offices in every state and 47 foreign countries, including Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) and Enforcement and Removal Operations (ERO).
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Mixed: ~7k ERO deportation officers + ~6k HSI special agents (field law-enforcement, lower eligibility ~0.20) blended with ~8k intel analysts, attorneys (OPLA), and HQ knowledge workers at ~0.80.
rows.notes: Includes OPLA attorneys and HSI cyber/financial-crime analysts who are heavy LLM users.

rows.headcount_quote: FEMA has more than 20,000 employees nationwide, including permanent full-time staff and a Reservist (intermittent) cadre deployed during disasters.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Mostly office-based program staff (grants, mitigation, recovery), policy analysts, and emergency-management specialists; ~35% are field/deployment Reservists doing inspections and on-site recovery work.
rows.notes: ~5k full-time CORE + Reservist mix swells during major disasters.

rows.headcount_source_title: About USCIS — U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
rows.headcount_quote: USCIS has approximately 21,000 government employees and contractors working at more than 200 offices across the world... adjudicating immigration benefits.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Adjudication-heavy bureau: ISOs (immigration services officers), attorneys, fraud detection specialists, and IT operate at desks reviewing case files — high LLM-plausible workforce.
rows.notes: Fee-funded; one of the most LLM-natural workforces in DHS.

rows.headcount_quote: TSA employs approximately 60,000 personnel, the majority of whom are Transportation Security Officers (TSOs) at more than 430 federalized airports.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: ~50k TSOs perform shift-based screening at checkpoints (excluded); ~10k include federal air marshals, inspectors, HQ admin, IT, and intel analysts who are LLM-plausible.
rows.notes: TSO workforce is the dominant exclusion.

rows.headcount_quote: The Secret Service employs approximately 8,200 personnel, including special agents, Uniformed Division officers, and administrative, professional, and technical support staff.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: ~3.5k special agents + ~1.6k Uniformed Division (field protective work, low eligibility); ~3k administrative/technical (cyber/financial-crimes analysts, IT, intel) are LLM-plausible.
rows.notes: Protective mission dominates; cyber/financial investigations workforce LLM-eligible.

rows.headcount_source_title: About CISA — Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
rows.headcount_quote: CISA's workforce of approximately 3,400 employees defends federal civilian executive branch networks and works with critical infrastructure partners.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Almost entirely cybersecurity analysts, threat hunters, vulnerability researchers, infrastructure-security specialists, and policy/comms staff — knowledge-work workforce.
rows.notes: Heavy contractor augmentation (~3-4x FTE). FTE-only here.

rows.headcount_quote: The Coast Guard is a maritime, military, multi-mission service... approximately 42,000 active duty members, 7,000 reservists, 8,700 full-time civilian employees, and 31,000 Auxiliarists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: ~42k active-duty enlisted/officers performing afloat/aviation/shore operations (low eligibility ~0.10) blended with ~8.7k civilians (HQ, engineering, acquisitions, IT) at ~0.80.
rows.notes: Total includes active duty + civilians; excludes ~31k unpaid Auxiliarists and ~7k reservists from total_headcount baseline.

rows.headcount_source_title: About S&T — DHS Science and Technology Directorate
rows.headcount_quote: S&T comprises approximately 460 federal employees plus contractors and partners across five laboratories... delivering science-based research, development, and innovation.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: R&D and engineering staff (PhD scientists, program managers, engineers); near-universally LLM-eligible knowledge workers.
rows.notes: FTE-only; lab contractor workforce excluded (~2-3x size).
